en.topic_title: NGO urges binding child sexual abuse sentencing guidelines in Hong Kong, as most jail terms fall ‘far below’ maximum
en.topic_summary:
Researchers have urged Hong Kong authorities to establish binding sentencing guidelines for perpetrators of child sexual abuse, saying that most jail terms are too low to reflect the gravity of the offences.



Hong Kong students. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. 



In the past 35 years, jail sentences handed down for the six gravest penetrative offences involving children ranged between 4.6 and 9.8 years, despite the crimes carrying a maximum penalty of life imprisonment, according to TALK Hong Kong.
